body:
## What it does

Built around a portable assistant that carries its own memory, keys, code and automations between tools rather than being locked to a single editor. This bot handles the launch side of that: the positioning, the announcement material and the follow-through once it is out.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @poteto shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
